name: spreewe-sdk-workspace
description: Workspace for the SpreeWe frontend integration packages (@spreewe/*). Not published.

scripts.test:integration: npm run build && cd ../webrtc-BE && npx vitest run --config ../webrtc-SDK/integration/vitest.config.ts
scripts.examples:build: npm run build && npm run build -w examples/chat-only -w examples/calls-only -w examples/combined
scripts.pack:all: npm run build && node -e "require('fs').mkdirSync('artifacts',{recursive:true})" && npm pack -w packages/core -w packages/ui -w packages/e2ee -w packages/contacts -w packages/chat -w packages/groups -w packages/files -w packages/notifications -w packages/meetings -w packages/calls --pack-destination ./artifacts
